steps.title: Define Application Metadata
steps.description: Create the app-meta.json file defining 'Hi How To Do' and namespace 'com.hihowtodo.app'.

steps.title: Configure Build Environment
steps.description: Set up build.gradle with targetSdkVersion 34, AGP 8.3.2, and Gradle 8.5 compatibility settings.

steps.title: Declare Application Manifest
steps.description: Configure AndroidManifest.xml with correct launcher Activity details, theme references, and the valid Android namespace.

steps.title: Create Screen Background Asset
steps.description: Design a smooth gradient background XML drawable for the application layout.

steps.title: Create Card Container Asset
steps.description: Design a rounded corner card container XML drawable to hold our content beautifully.

steps.title: Create Button Style Background
steps.description: Design a custom colored interactive button XML background drawable with rounded corners.

steps.title: Implement Main Layout Interface
steps.description: Create activity_main.xml using safe system components, ScrollView, modern spacing, and visual cues for 'Hi! How to do?'.

steps.title: Implement MainActivity Logic
steps.description: Write MainActivity.java using standard Java 8 syntax (no lambdas) to manage interactive state, display daily how-to tips, and handle click events.

steps.title: Verify Manifest & Layout Namespaces
steps.description: Validate that all XML files strictly use correct android schemas to guarantee success of compiling stages.

steps.title: Building Hi How To Do
steps.description: Execute gradle assembleDebug to build the final premium Android executable.
